scientific_integrity.limitations: Composite odd label counts are shown nonfree but their quotient spaces are not classified; full dihedral topology is asserted only for five labels; no independent audit.
scientific_integrity.statement: Topological orbit-space identifications, with the five-label computation reproducible by a standalone exact checker. The convex polytopal realization is prior work, not claimed as new.

title: Signed-cycle lens spaces and a dihedral three-sphere quotient of balanced Bier spheres
